answer: Trust-Graph Random Walk Weighting. 1) Nodes begin with a trust score. 2) A random walk accumulates trust; the delta from neighbors is weighted by their score. 3) Dense, karst-like clusters with high accumulated trust are flagged. This prevents significant delta contributions from fake identities. Cost per fake identity: 0.1 ETH. Total cost for N identities: N 0.1 ETH. Alternatively, 100 new identities cost 5 ETH. This is like trying to build a substantial dune with grains of sand that are themselves constantly eroding.
